ip_address.description: Optional. Static IP of the ScreenLogic protocol adapter. If unset, the plugin finds it via UDP broadcast on your LAN (note: broadcast fails on networks where 255.255.255.255 does not route to the LAN).
ip_address.title: IP Address

name.description: Name shown in the Home app.
name.title: Name

password.description: Optional. ScreenLogic gateway password, if your adapter has one set.
password.title: Password

port.description: Optional. Port of the ScreenLogic protocol adapter.
port.title: IP Port
